questions.prompt: Which statement best summarises the central message of this lesson?
questions.answer: Art is shaped by interpretation, access, and social conditions.
options: Art is shaped by interpretation, access, and social conditions.
Every viewer interprets an artwork identically.
Moving a work never changes its meaning.
Ticket sales reveal every benefit of a public arts programme.
questions.explanation: Metnin genel sonucu: Art is shaped by interpretation, access, and social conditions.

source.en: Assessing cultural activity therefore involves more than attendance figures and includes the kinds of reflection and participation it makes possible.
source.tr: Bu nedenle kültürel etkinliği değerlendirmek katılım sayılarından fazlasını içerir ve mümkün kıldığı düşünme ve katılım türlerini de kapsar.

questions.prompt: Which statement is NOT supported by the lesson?
questions.answer: Every viewer interprets an artwork identically.
options: Every viewer interprets an artwork identically.
A new sculpture appears in a square, and people stop to look at it.
A museum invites residents to contribute objects and stories to an exhibition about everyday life.
Assessing cultural activity therefore involves more than attendance figures and includes the kinds of reflection and participation it makes possible.
questions.explanation: Diğer üç seçenek metinde bulunur. Seçilen iddia metnin verdiği bilgilerle uyuşmaz. Ana düşünce: Art is shaped by interpretation, access, and social conditions.

source.en: A new sculpture appears in a square, and people stop to look at it. A museum invites residents to contribute objects and stories to an exhibition about everyday life.
